facts.fact: Minister of State for Health Iziaq Salako said the National Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics under NITDA is leading projects to integrate AI into healthcare delivery.
Minister of State for Health Iziaq Salako said the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy was launched in September 2025 and identifies healthcare as a priority sector for AI adoption.

Minister of State for Health Iziaq Salako described the Nigeria Atlas for Languages and AI at Scale as Nigeria's first open-source, multilingual and multimodal large language model trained on local language data.
